A '''village''' was located in a [[Swamp/Legends|marsh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Databank" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]</ref> during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] student [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]] escaped the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|besieged]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. After evading Trade Federation [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] and patrols by [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] for [[Standard day/Legends|days]], Minnau found shelter in the village and remained there safely until the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|end]] of the invasion.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The marsh village was mentioned in Teckla Minnau's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry<ref name="Databank" /> published on [[StarWars.com]] in [[2008]]. The entry was created as part of the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] fan club feature "[[What's The Story?]],"<ref name="PP">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> in which winning subscriber-submitted entries would be selected for official acknowledgment in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="Story">{{SWArchive|url=hyperspace/about/news/news20050624.html|text=Hyperspace Presents: What's the Story?}}</ref> Minnau's entry was written by the user [[Evan Burger|ShadowCultist]].<ref name="Databank" />
